name: Solaris DevShop
tagline: Chief of Staff coordination and 61 specialist workflows in one plugin.
description: Bundles a Chief of Staff coordinator and 61 specialist workflows for engineering, QA, security, data, design and delivery. The bounded solaris_intake tool returns an accountable role assignment; specialist workflows include contained local delivery, recovery and evidence tools. The full skill bodies and resources ship together in the package. No Docker installation, background service or repository/account access grant is triggered by skill loading.

install.notes: Includes Chief of Staff and 61 specialist skills. Local workflow scripts require their documented runtimes and the host permission checks.
